name: Listen2It – Text-to-speech audio article
author: Listen2It

sections.description:
Listen2It helps you convert your articles and blog posts into audio versions instantly and with zero additional effort using neural-network based lifelike voices in 145+ languages. Simply sign up for a free account and install this WordPress plugin to distribute and publish your content in audio versions on your website/blog and across all popular podcasting platforms.

With 500+ voice styles across 145+ languages and advanced voice customization capabilities, you can create your unique brand of voice within minutes. Use our fully customizable SEO friendly players to create an “on-brand” voice experience for your users.

All this with a free account. No credit card is required.

Why Add Audio to Your Blog?

Modern audiences are multi-tasking and mobile. Whether they’re commuting, working, cooking, or relaxing – they prefer listening over reading. Audio content lets you reach your audience wherever they are, in the format they prefer.

  • According to NPR & Edison Research, nearly 2/3 of consumers prefer listening to reading.
  • Audio articles boost engagement, time-on-site, and content recall.
  • Stand out in the crowded content landscape with a unique “voice-first” experience.
  • Offer an inclusive, accessible format for visually impaired or on-the-go users.
  • Add audio as a value-added service to grow subscribers and loyalty.

So go ahead, grow your audience with audio. It’s easy!

Listen2It Features:

  • 500+ Voice Styles across 145+ Languages. See our full list of languages
  • High-quality lifelike voices using advanced neural-network engine
  • Instant audio generation. No extra effort, you focus on creating content and we will do everything audio automatically.
  • Create your own audio brand by customizing advanced voice parameters like speed, volume, pitch, timbre, style etc.
  • Fully customizable SEO friendly players in a variety of layouts including inline, static and minimized. Mobile friendly.
  • Inbuilt audio hosting on fast global CDN servers
  • Advanced audio analytics to see how your audience is interacting with audio content
  • Publish your audio content as a podcast on iTunes, Google Podcasts, Spotify and all leading podcast networks
  • Increase your earnings with audio advertising

Convert Your Blog into a Podcast

With Listen2It you can easily convert your blog or website into a podcast. Simply enable the podcast RSS Feed in your Listen2It account. Manually select which audio articles are published or automatically publish them all.

Distribute your content over iTunes, Spotify, Google Podcasts and other major podcast platforms and get access to millions of podcast listeners you were missing out on before.

Free Service

You can get started with a free forever Listen2It. The free account comes with 5 new audio articles every month. We keep it free by being ad-supported.

You can switch to our paid plans to get access to a host of advanced features, more monthly articles, no advertising. We even support multiple websites/blogs out of the box.

sections.faq:
How is it free?

We are able to offer a forever free plan by making it ad-supported. Your audience will hear a short audio ad before or during the audio article. You can always switch to our paid plans to remove the advertising. See our full plan list at https://www.getlisten2it.com/pricing/

Which languages are supported?

We support 145+ languages and 500+ voice styles. You can view the full list here:
https://www.getlisten2it.com/pages/text-to-speech-voices

How do I customize the Listen2It Player?

Log in to your Listen2It dashboard (https://dashboard.getlisten2it.com/) and configure the player settings. Once saved, the updated player settings automatically reflect on your website/blog.

How do I change the voice/language which Listen2It uses?

You can log in to your Listen2It dashboard and configure the voice settings. New settings apply to future articles. For older articles, you can manually re-convert them from the dashboard.

If you have many old articles, email support@getlisten2it.com and we will assist. Re-conversions count toward monthly quota.

Does it work for all types of posts?

Yes, the Listen2It player works for all types of posts. You can also disable the player for any post using your Listen2It dashboard.

Can Listen2It convert audio for WordPress pages and custom post types, or is it limited to blog posts only?

Yes, the Listen2It plugin fully supports WordPress pages and custom post types in addition to standard blog posts.
You can easily enable audio generation for:
– Static pages (About, Services, Course Details, etc.)
– Custom post types (Portfolios, Lessons, Testimonials, Events, Courses, etc.)

This makes it ideal for content-rich websites, including e-learning platforms, publishers, and marketing sites that use custom content structures. Simply select the post types you want to enable in the plugin settings — no coding required.
With this flexibility, you can offer a seamless audio experience across your entire site, not just your blog.
